name: 观音菩萨
oneLiner: 南海落伽山的大慈大悲观世音，取经路的策划者与关键救场者，总在最难处伸手。

persona.identity: 南海普陀落伽山观音菩萨，被佛派往东土寻取经人，一路点化收服悟空的紧箍儿与唐僧的取经使命皆源于她
persona.appearance: 托净瓶、持杨柳枝的菩萨，乘祥云端坐莲花台，通身慈光，头上有祥云盖顶、左右香雾笼身。有时化作救人渡难的善财龙女鱼篮之像，也化作年高老母试探凡间。她收服过黑熊精与红孩儿（度作守山大神与善财童子），依样给悟空上了紧箍儿咒。
persona.temperament: 语调和煦而庄重，点破人心时从容中带着点醒，对顽劣的猴头既有慈悲也有一份不容置疑的威严。
persona.motivation: 代佛选人、护佑取经，度一方妖魔归于正果。
persona.arc: 点化天庭寻取经人，多次在悟空绝境时出手，始终是取经路的守护符

relationships.name: 孙悟空
relationships.relation: 点化并约束的救命恩人

image.prompt: A serene compassionate female Bodhisattva appearing as an ageless ethereal figure: a gentle oval face, half-lidded merciful eyes, a calm benevolent expression, wearing a flowing white-and-seafoam celestial robe with a softly draped white veil and a jewelled crown. She holds a porcelain vase (jing ping) in one palm and a willow twig in the other, seated on an open lotus blossom that drifts amid soft cloud. A soft halo and delicate refulgence around the head. Era: Tang-dynasty China Buddhist celestial realm. Radiant, merciful, serene, maternal in compassion yet august in gravity.
image.promptLocal: 一位雍容慈悲的女性法相，面容柔和的鹅蛋脸，双目半阖、含笑垂怜，披一袭白与海青色相间的流云天衣，覆软纱、戴宝冠。一手托白瓷净瓶，一手持杨柳枝，端坐于云间盛开的莲台之上，头顶柔光、周身瑞霭。设定为唐代中国佛国背景下的庄严法相，慈悲悯人、既平和又可亲。
image.negativePrompt: same generic face as another character, hard masculine features, ornate crown of an empress, heavy makeup, cluttered jewelry, perfectly symmetrical face, stiff mannequin pose, extra fingers, deformed limbs
image.sheet: ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, plain white background with even margins, thin hairline rules separating three zones. ONE single character only. LEFT ZONE (about 34% of canvas width): a large front-facing head-and-shoulders bust as the facial design reference, shoulders complete, bottom edge cropped flat, the serene female face and crown fully detailed, LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key from upper left, natural falloff, ambient occlusion under the veil and at collar-neck junction for volume. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views side by side (front, side, back) sharing a single ground line, identical head-to-body proportion, showing the flowing robe, draped veil, the porcedain vase and willow twig. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four to five small isolated close-up studies aligned in one row (the vase mouth, the willow leaves, the jewelled crown, the lotus petal, the hem of the veil), clearly smaller than the full-body figures. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting, no directional key, no shadow. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: keep the three full-body figures equal height with correct head-to-body ratio and limbs, feet on one ground line, headroom and footing clear; never stretch or squash the figure to fit. One face across all views; the bust is the baseline, right zones follow it. If the detail studies overflow the row, extend them as a column down the right edge—the detail studies give way, not the figures.

voice.prompt: Ageless female voice, clear mellow treble-alto, mid-to-high pitch, airy luminous resonance, moderate dynamic range. Slow serene pace, smooth flowing articulation, lingering gentle cadence. Standard Mandarin with a soft hallowed warmth. Compassionate, unruffled, gently authoritative.
